ms.name: Manuscript
ms.notes: The Manuscript agent skill is installed in .claude/skills/manuscript and .agents/skills/manuscript: SKILL.md with references/ beside it. Load it before writing code and open the reference its table of contents points to, and use `ms search <name or words>` to look up standard-library APIs before reading files. `ms help <code>` explains a diagnostic. `ms help` lists commands.
